say:1:1331061001:1.text: I have scarves dyed with sapphirine blossoms and fresh caviar.
say:1:1331061001:1.source_cn: 用蓝绒花作染料染成的丝巾，还有前几天刚腌制好的鱼子酱。
say:1:1331061001:1.male: I have scarves dyed with sapphirine blossoms and fresh caviar.
say:1:1331061001:1.female: I have scarves dyed with sapphirine blossoms and fresh caviar.

say:2:1331061002:1.text: We have all kinds of snacks and other stuff. Just buy anything that tickles your fancy.
say:2:1331061002:1.source_cn: 吃的用的全都有，就看你喜欢什么了。
